title: DCAF15 with E7820, recruiting RBM39
shows: The largest cavity in the benchmark at 1274 cubic angstroms, which makes it the clearest illustration of what the cavity view is for -- that is the space chemistry would have to fill. One caveat is visible in its own numbers: the face has a directionality of 0.34, barely above the threshold where the tool stops trusting the approach direction at all.
